events.title: BLIGHTEN Reaches 30,000 Wishlists! - Next Fest Update
events.summary: After almost 8 months of development BLIGHTEN as just reached 30,000 wishlists! this is a huge milestone for a solo developer like myself and I am forever thankful for all 30,000 of you players ready to brave the horror's of the facility. BLIGHTEN is taking part in October next fest! Development as also gotten to the stage that I'm ready to take part in the upcoming October next fest, I also have a big update planned for the event - here is what to expect. HARD Difficulty (Nightmare coming soon?

events.title: BLIGHTEN Playtest Closing!
events.summary: BLIGHTEN Playtest is now closing! I've got all the feedback that I need and it's clear there is still a lot of issues with the game.. (the point of playtesting!) and now I can start working on fixing them. So what's next?I'm hoping to release the demo in the coming weeks, expect it to be much better then the playtest!Provide your feedback here: Google Form come drop the Discord by, heres the link: https://discord.gg/jVFrPeZaMH
